'''House a'Roos''' is a house from [[Murandy]]. 

Its only known member is Lady [[Segan do Avharin a'Roos]], one of the heads of the Murandian delegation that meets with [[Andor]]an nobility and the [[Salidar]] [[Rebel Aes Sedai|Aes Sedai]] on the Feast of Abram.{{ref/book|8|17}}
